## Goal
Deliver relic import, speed auto-fill, and interactive team tools with stable UX.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add scanner JSON upload UI and parsing path.
- [ ] Support core relic model fields (set, slot, main stat, substats, level, equipped character).
- [ ] Aggregate relic stats by character and auto-fill team speed.
- [ ] Add draggable team slot reorder.
- [ ] Add click-to-view relic details for each team unit.
- [ ] Add UID lookup route with cache, rate limit, and custom User-Agent.
- [ ] Verify UID coverage behavior and document limitations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Importing valid scanner JSON updates speed where names match.
- [ ] Invalid JSON import gives clear error without data loss.
- [ ] Reordering team updates turn order immediately.
- [ ] Relic details are visible for imported units.
- [ ] UID route follows cache/rate-limit rules.

## Notes
- Confirm scanner and API usage follows tool and game terms.
